description: This file defines the NotifyRespInd class, which represents an MMS Notification Response Indication PDU. It includes constructors, accessors, and mutators for various headers related to MMS notifications, such as transaction ID and status.

classes.name: NotifyRespInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS Notification Response Indication PDU with methods to access and modify its headers.

methods.name: NotifyRespInd(int, byte[], int)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new NotifyRespInd with specified MMS version, transaction ID, and status.

methods.name: NotifyRespInd(PduHeaders)
methods.description: Constructor to create a NotifyRespInd from existing headers.

methods.name: getReportAllowed
methods.description: Returns the value of the X-Mms-Report-Allowed header.

methods.name: setReportAllowed
methods.description: Sets the value of the X-Mms-Report-Allowed header.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the value of the X-Mms-Status header.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the value of the X-Mms-Status header.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the transaction ID associated with the notification.

methods.name: setTransactionId
methods.description: Sets the transaction ID for the notification.
